title: Distance Between Two 3D Objects
description: Calculate the Euclidean distance between two 3D objects in a virtual scene.
inputFormat: Six space-separated integers: x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2
outputFormat: A single float rounded to 2 decimal places.

starterCode.python:
import math
x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2 = map(int, input().split())
print(f"{math.dist((x1,y1,z1),(x2,y2,z2)):.2f}")

title: Translate a 3D Object
description: In Unity, translating an object modifies its transform.position. Given an initial position (x, y, z) and a translation vector (tx, ty, tz), find the new position.
inputFormat: Six space-separated integers: x y z tx ty tz
outputFormat: Three space-separated integers representing the new coordinates.

starterCode.python:
x,y,z,tx,ty,tz = map(int, input().split())
print(f"{x+tx} {y+ty} {z+tz}")

title: Scale an AR Model
description: Given the base dimensions (width, height, depth) of a 3D model and a uniform scaling factor S, find the new dimensions.
inputFormat: Four space-separated numbers: w, h, d (integers) and S (float)
outputFormat: Three space-separated floats rounded to 2 decimal places representing the new w, h, and d.

starterCode.python:
w, h, d, s = map(float, input().split())
print(f"{w*s:.2f} {h*s:.2f} {d*s:.2f}")

title: Rotate a UI Element
description: In VR/AR interfaces, 2D UI elements are sometimes rotated. Given a point (x, y) and an angle in degrees, compute its new coordinates after rotating around the origin (0,0) counter-clockwise.
inputFormat: Three space-separated numbers: x, y (floats) and angle (float).
outputFormat: Two space-separated floats rounded to 2 decimal places.
note: Use x_new = x*cos(A) - y*sin(A), y_new = x*sin(A) + y*cos(A). Convert angle to radians.

starterCode.python:
import math
x,y,ang = map(float, input().split())
rad = math.radians(ang)
nx = x*math.cos(rad) - y*math.sin(rad)
ny = x*math.sin(rad) + y*math.cos(rad)
print(f"{nx:.2f} {ny:.2f}")

title: Simulating 3D Projectiles
description: Calculate the maximum height (H) and time of flight (T) of a 3D projectile launched with an initial velocity V at an angle Theta (in degrees) from the ground. Assume gravity g = 9.8 m/s^2.
inputFormat: Two space-separated floats: V and Theta.
outputFormat: Two space-separated floats rounded to 2 decimal places representing H and T.

starterCode.python:
import math
v, th = map(float, input().split())
rad = math.radians(th)
h = (v * math.sin(rad))**2 / (2 * 9.8)
t = 2 * v * math.sin(rad) / 9.8
print(f"{h:.2f} {t:.2f}")

description: Determine if a given 3D point (px, py, pz) lies inside an axis-aligned bounding box defined by its minimum coordinates (minX, minY, minZ) and maximum coordinates (maxX, maxY, maxZ).
inputFormat: Nine space-separated integers: px py pz minX minY minZ maxX maxY maxZ

note: Compare each coordinate with min and max.

title: Orthographic Camera Projection
description: An orthographic camera projects a 3D point (x, y, z) onto a 2D plane (ignoring perspective). If the camera looks down the Z-axis, find the projected (x, y) coordinates.
inputFormat: Three space-separated floats: x, y, z.
outputFormat: Two space-separated floats rounded to 2 decimal places: x and y.

starterCode.python:
x,y,z = map(float, input().split())
print(f"{x:.2f} {y:.2f}")

title: Flappy Bird Collision
description: In a Flappy Bird clone built with Unity, the bird is a circle with center (bx, by) and radius r. A pipe is a rectangle defined by bottom-left corner (px, py), width w, and height h. Check if they intersect.
inputFormat: Seven space-separated floats: bx by r px py w h
outputFormat: Print "Collision" if they intersect, else "Safe".
note: Find the closest point on the rectangle to the circle center, and check the distance.

starterCode.python:
bx,by,r,px,py,w,h = map(float, input().split())
cx = max(px, min(bx, px+w))
cy = max(py, min(by, py+h))
dx, dy = bx - cx, by - cy
if dx*dx + dy*dy <= r*r:
    print("Collision")
else:
    print("Safe")

title: Solar System Animation
description: A planet revolves around a star (at 0,0) in a circular orbit of radius R with an angular speed of W degrees per second. Find its position (x, y) after T seconds if it starts at (R, 0).
inputFormat: Three space-separated floats: R, W, T.
outputFormat: Two space-separated floats rounded to 2 decimal places for x and y.
note: Angle = W * T. Use trig functions.

starterCode.python:
import math
r,w,t = map(float, input().split())
ang = math.radians(w*t)
print(f"{r*math.cos(ang):.2f} {r*math.sin(ang):.2f}")

title: Animation Frames Count
description: You are creating an animation clip in Blender. Given the duration in seconds and the framerate (FPS), calculate the total number of frames.
inputFormat: Two integers: duration and fps.
outputFormat: A single integer for total frames.

starterCode.python:
d, f = map(int, input().split())
print(d*f)

title: Linear Interpolation (Lerp)
description: In Unity, Vector3.Lerp smoothly interpolates between two points A and B by a factor t (0 to 1). Given A(x1,y1,z1), B(x2,y2,z2) and t, find the interpolated point.
inputFormat: Seven space-separated floats: x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2 t
outputFormat: Three space-separated floats rounded to 2 decimal places.

starterCode.python:
x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2,t = map(float, input().split())
print(f"{x1+(x2-x1)*t:.2f} {y1+(y2-y1)*t:.2f} {z1+(z2-z1)*t:.2f}")

title: Windmill Rotation State
description: A windmill modeled in Blender rotates around the Z-axis. It starts at an angle of 0 degrees and rotates at R revolutions per minute. What is its angle (modulo 360) after S seconds?
inputFormat: Two floats: R and S.
outputFormat: A single float representing the angle [0, 360), rounded to 2 decimal places.

starterCode.python:
r, s = map(float, input().split())
ang = ((r * 360 / 60) * s) % 360
print(f"{ang:.2f}")

title: Calculate Face Normal
description: In 3D graphics, the normal of a triangular face with vertices A, B, C is essential for lighting. Calculate the unnormalized cross product (B-A) x (C-A).
inputFormat: Nine space-separated floats for A(x,y,z), B(x,y,z), C(x,y,z).
outputFormat: Three space-separated floats rounded to 2 decimal places.
note: If U = B-A and V = C-A, normal is (UyVz - UzVy, UzVx - UxVz, UxVy - UyVx).

starterCode.python:
ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz,cx,cy,cz = map(float, input().split())
ux,uy,uz = bx-ax, by-ay, bz-az
vx,vy,vz = cx-ax, cy-ay, cz-az
nx = uy*vz - uz*vy
ny = uz*vx - ux*vz
nz = ux*vy - uy*vx
print(f"{nx:.2f} {ny:.2f} {nz:.2f}")

title: Lighting Intensity (Dot Product)
description: A basic diffuse lighting shader computes the dot product between the surface normal N and the light direction L. Given normalized vectors N and L, compute max(0, N dot L).
inputFormat: Six space-separated floats: Nx Ny Nz Lx Ly Lz.
outputFormat: A single float rounded to 2 decimal places.
note: Compute dot product, then take max with 0.

starterCode.python:
nx,ny,nz,lx,ly,lz = map(float, input().split())
dp = nx*lx + ny*ly + nz*lz
print(f"{max(0, dp):.2f}")

title: Texture Color Blending
description: Blend two RGB colors C1 and C2 based on an alpha value A (0 to 1). Result = C1*(1-A) + C2*A. Colors are given as integers 0-255.
inputFormat: Seven numbers: R1 G1 B1 R2 G2 B2 A (A is float).
outputFormat: Three space-separated integers representing the resulting RGB (rounded down to nearest int).
note: Apply the formula and use integer casting.

starterCode.python:
r1,g1,b1,r2,g2,b2,a = input().split()
r1,g1,b1,r2,g2,b2 = map(int, [r1,g1,b1,r2,g2,b2])
a = float(a)
r = int(r1*(1-a) + r2*a)
g = int(g1*(1-a) + g2*a)
b = int(b1*(1-a) + b2*a)
print(f"{r} {g} {b}")

title: Audio Clip Duration
description: Given the file size S in bytes, sample rate SR in Hz, channels C, and bits per sample B, calculate the duration of the audio clip in seconds.
inputFormat: Four integers: S, SR, C, B.
outputFormat: A single float rounded to 2 decimal places.

starterCode.python:
s, sr, c, b = map(int, input().split())
dur = s / (sr * c * (b / 8))
print(f"{dur:.2f}")

title: AR Marker Distance
description: In an AR application, two physical markers are tracked. Their 3D coordinates in the camera space are provided. Find the physical distance between them.
inputFormat: Six floats: x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2.
outputFormat: A float rounded to 2 decimal places.

starterCode.python:
import math
x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2 = map(float, input().split())
d = math.dist((x1,y1,z1), (x2,y2,z2))
print(f"{d:.2f}")

title: Sphere Collider Intersection
description: Check if two spherical colliders in Unity intersect. They are defined by their centers (x,y,z) and radii r.
inputFormat: Eight floats: x1 y1 z1 r1 x2 y2 z2 r2.
outputFormat: Print "Intersect" or "Separate".
note: Check if distance between centers <= r1 + r2.

starterCode.python:
import math
x1,y1,z1,r1,x2,y2,z2,r2 = map(float, input().split())
d = math.dist((x1,y1,z1), (x2,y2,z2))
if d <= r1 + r2:
    print("Intersect")
else:
    print("Separate")

title: Point Light Attenuation
description: The intensity of a point light decreases with the square of the distance. Given the initial intensity I0 at 1 meter, find the intensity at distance D.
inputFormat: Two floats: I0 and D.
outputFormat: A single float rounded to 2 decimal places.

starterCode.python:
i0, d = map(float, input().split())
print(f"{i0 / (d*d):.2f}")

title: Terrain Grid Vertices
description: When building a terrain in Unity, it is represented as a grid of N by M cells. Each cell is a quad. How many vertices are required in total for the grid?
inputFormat: Two integers: N and M.
outputFormat: A single integer representing the number of vertices.

starterCode.python:
n, m = map(int, input().split())
print((n+1)*(m+1))

title: Gravity Simulation
description: An object is dropped in a VR environment from a height H with zero initial velocity. Calculate its height after T seconds. Use g = 9.8 m/s^2. If it hits the ground (0), it stops.
inputFormat: Two floats: H and T.
outputFormat: A single float rounded to 2 decimal places.
note: Height = H - 0.5 * g * T^2. Max with 0.

starterCode.python:
h, t = map(float, input().split())
res = h - 0.5 * 9.8 * t**2
print(f"{max(0, res):.2f}")

title: Avatar Movement
description: A player moves their avatar forward at speed F and sideways at speed S for T seconds. Calculate the total distance covered.
inputFormat: Three floats: F, S, T.
outputFormat: A single float rounded to 2 decimal places.
note: Velocity V = sqrt(F^2 + S^2). Distance = V * T.

starterCode.python:
import math
f, s, t = map(float, input().split())
v = math.sqrt(f**2 + s**2)
print(f"{v*t:.2f}")

title: Viewport Clipping
description: Check if a 2D screen coordinate (X, Y) is visible on a screen of width W and height H. Origin (0,0) is bottom-left.
inputFormat: Four integers: X Y W H.
outputFormat: Print "Visible" or "Clipped".

title: Mesh Triangle Area
description: Calculate the area of a triangular face in a 3D mesh given its three vertices A, B, C.
inputFormat: Nine floats: Ax Ay Az Bx By Bz Cx Cy Cz.
outputFormat: A single float rounded to 2 decimal places.
note: Area is half the magnitude of the cross product of vectors AB and AC.

starterCode.python:
import math
ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz,cx,cy,cz = map(float, input().split())
ux,uy,uz = bx-ax, by-ay, bz-az
vx,vy,vz = cx-ax, cy-ay, cz-az
nx = uy*vz - uz*vy
ny = uz*vx - ux*vz
nz = ux*vy - uy*vx
area = 0.5 * math.sqrt(nx**2 + ny**2 + nz**2)
print(f"{area:.2f}")

title: Angle Between 3D Vectors
description: Calculate the angle in degrees between two 3D vectors U and V.
inputFormat: Six floats: Ux Uy Uz Vx Vy Vz.
outputFormat: A single float rounded to 2 decimal places.
note: Use dot product and arccos. Angle = acos((U dot V) / (|U||V|)) * 180 / PI.

starterCode.python:
import math
ux,uy,uz,vx,vy,vz = map(float, input().split())
dot = ux*vx + uy*vy + uz*vz
magU = math.sqrt(ux**2 + uy**2 + uz**2)
magV = math.sqrt(vx**2 + vy**2 + vz**2)
ang = math.degrees(math.acos(round(dot/(magU*magV), 5)))
print(f"{ang:.2f}")

title: Light Reflection Vector
description: Given an incoming light vector I and a surface normal N, compute the reflection vector R = I - 2*(I dot N)*N.
inputFormat: Six floats: Ix Iy Iz Nx Ny Nz.
outputFormat: Three space-separated floats rounded to 2 decimal places.

starterCode.python:
ix,iy,iz,nx,ny,nz = map(float, input().split())
dot = ix*nx + iy*ny + iz*nz
rx = ix - 2*dot*nx
ry = iy - 2*dot*ny
rz = iz - 2*dot*nz
print(f"{rx:.2f} {ry:.2f} {rz:.2f}")

title: AR Perspective Scaling
description: To maintain perspective, an AR object must be scaled down as it moves further away. Given base distance D0, base scale S0, and new distance D1, compute the new scale S1 = S0 * (D0 / D1).
inputFormat: Three floats: D0 S0 D1.
outputFormat: A single float rounded to 2 decimal places.

starterCode.python:
d0, s0, d1 = map(float, input().split())
print(f"{s0 * (d0 / d1):.2f}")

title: 3D Midpoint Calculation
description: Find the exact midpoint between two 3D positions in an AR scene.
inputFormat: Six floats: x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2.
outputFormat: Three space-separated floats rounded to 2 decimal places.

title: Normalize a 3D Vector
description: Convert a 3D vector into a unit vector (magnitude of 1) in the same direction.
inputFormat: Three floats: x, y, z.
outputFormat: Three space-separated floats rounded to 2 decimal places.
note: Divide each component by the magnitude.

starterCode.python:
import math
x,y,z = map(float, input().split())
mag = math.sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z)
print(f"{x/mag:.2f} {y/mag:.2f} {z/mag:.2f}")

title: Animation Frame Interpolation
description: Given the value of a property at frame F1 is V1, and at frame F2 is V2, find the linearly interpolated value at frame F (where F1 <= F <= F2).
inputFormat: Five numbers: F1 (int), V1 (float), F2 (int), V2 (float), F (int).
outputFormat: A single float rounded to 2 decimal places.

starterCode.python:
f1,v1,f2,v2,f = input().split()
f1, f2, f = int(f1), int(f2), int(f)
v1, v2 = float(v1), float(v2)
res = v1 + (v2 - v1) * (f - f1) / (f2 - f1)
print(f"{res:.2f}")
